records.title: Ferrotech Systems — FTC Data-Handling Inquiry
records.subject: Marcus Webb (Co-Founder & CTO), via prior venture Ferrotech Systems
records.summary: In 2019, the FTC opened an inquiry into Ferrotech Systems' data-handling practices following a customer complaint. The matter was resolved in 2020 via a consent agreement: Ferrotech made no admission of wrongdoing, paid a modest civil settlement, and agreed to updated data-handling procedures. No further obligations or open proceedings remain. Ferrotech had already ceased operations by the time the consent agreement was signed.

No further exposure remains from this matter.
